skill.name: OKRs
skill.description: Writing objectives and key results, setting cadence, and avoiding common stretch-goal failures.
skill.summary: O is qualitative and directional; KR is a measurable outcome, not a task (razor: ship the task, the number didn't move, was it still success?). 3-5 Os, 3-5 KRs per O. 0.7 = green; 1.0 for two quarters = sandbagging. Two-tier commit (1.0, comp) vs stretch (0.7, decoupled). Quarterly cadence, weekly check-in, week-4 reset. Decouple from comp or stretch dies; alignment over cascade past 2 layers.
